items.title:
io.evitadb:evita_root 2026.2.0 发布, Evita is a specialized database with easy-to-use API for e-commerce systems. Purpose of this research is
		creating fast and scalable engine that handles all complex tasks that e-commerce systems has to deal with on
		daily basis.

		Evita should operate as a fast secondary lookup / search index used by application frontends. We aim for order
		of magnitude better latency (10x faster or better) for common e-commerce tasks than other solutions based on SQL
		or NoSQL databases on the same hardware specification. Evita should not be used for storing and handling primary
		data, and we don't aim for ACID properties nor data corruption guarantees. Evita "index" must be treated
		as something that could be dropped any time and built up from scratch easily again.

items.content_text:
io.github.ghosthack:imageio-native-parent 2.0.0 发布, Java ImageIO readers that delegate to platform-native image decoding APIs
        (Apple ImageIO, Windows Imaging Component) via Project Panama (FFM API).
        Decode HEIC, AVIF, WEBP, JPEG 2000, camera RAW, and more through standard
        javax.imageio.ImageIO.read().

items.title:
io.github.ghosthack:imageio-native-vips 2.0.0 发布, Optional ImageIO reader backed by libvips via Project Panama.
        Adds cross-platform support (macOS, Linux, Windows) for HEIC, AVIF, WebP,
        JPEG 2000, PDF, SVG, EXR, FITS, and more. Requires libvips installed on
        the system. Not included in the imageio-native aggregator — add this
        dependency explicitly to opt in.

items.title:
io.github.ghosthack:imageio-native 2.0.0 发布, Cross-platform aggregator: pulls in both imageio-native-apple (macOS) and
        imageio-native-windows (Windows) as transitive dependencies. At runtime,
        only the SPI matching the current OS activates; the other is a no-op.
        Add this single dependency to support HEIC/AVIF/WEBP/etc. on any platform.

io.github.amaye15:json-tools-rs-spark 0.9.11 发布, JVM (Java/Scala) bindings for json-tools-rs, exposed as Apache Spark UDFs for use
    in Databricks Jobs/notebooks on classic compute and other Spark workloads (not
    usable inside a Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline -- Databricks does not permit JVM
    libraries on pipeline compute at all). Backed by a JNI shim over the Rust core
    (see ../src/jvm.rs).
